first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person wearing a brown flat hat, a light blue long-sleeved shirt, gray-green bib overalls, and dark boots, carrying a light gray device.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A goose with a white body, a slender long neck, and an orange beak, legs, and feet.

entities.name: group of white marked bags
entities.identification: Two flat, bulging white bags beside the door, with blue ends and red rectangles and short bars.

entities.name: red lawn mower
entities.identification: A push-operated device with a red body, a dark gray circular top component, gray-black wheels, and a long dark handle.

entities.name: pond surface
entities.identification: A small exposed area of light blue water inside the pond-edge stones at the lower left.

entities.name: pond-edge stones
entities.identification: Light gray stones of varying sizes with rounded, irregular outlines at the pond edge.

entities.name: aquatic plants
entities.identification: Pale green, narrow, long, pointed leaves partially exposed between the pond-edge stones.

entities.name: gray-green lawn
entities.identification: A large area of gray-green ground covering the surroundings of the path and entrance, with fine, short grass blades along the edges.

entities.name: light gray path
entities.identification: A light gray garden path crossing the lawn, with curved edges and fine seams.

entities.name: wooden bench
entities.identification: A brown bench with a slatted backrest, long seat, armrests, and legs.

entities.name: blue square object
entities.identification: A flat, thin, nearly square blue object on the bench seat, with a dark blue center, light blue edges, and one protruding corner.

entities.name: reddish-brown wall
entities.identification: Low reddish-brown enclosing walls on both sides of the entrance, with courses and block-like color variations.

entities.name: open wooden door
entities.identification: A light brown plank door open outward from the entrance, with vertical boards, horizontal connecting boards, and dark hardware.

entities.name: orange hose
entities.identification: A slender orange hose laid along the base of the wall and curving beside the door.

entities.name: long-handled shovel beside the door
entities.identification: A light brown long-shafted tool leaning diagonally beside the door, with a dark D-shaped grip at the upper end and part of a gray shovel blade exposed below.

entities.name: light gray stepping stone
entities.identification: Light gray, nearly rectangular stone slabs laid separately around the entrance and throughout the garden, with gaps of grass between them.

entities.name: wooden notice board
entities.identification: A light brown, two-post wooden-framed notice board, with a blue left panel and a light blue right panel containing light-colored rectangular blocks.

entities.name: wall vines
entities.identification: Dense clusters of dark and light green leaves covering the top and part of the wall.

entities.name: vegetable-bed soil
entities.identification: Dark brown soil exposed between the plants in the vegetable bed.

entities.name: wooden planting container
entities.identification: Including a low wooden vegetable-bed frame and a tall light brown planter with upright walls, horizontal seams, and corner posts.

entities.name: vegetable-bed plants
entities.identification: Clusters of green leaves arranged in rows in the vegetable bed, with small orange areas exposed beneath some of them.

entities.name: white-flowered plant
entities.identification: Dense green foliage in the tall planter, with small white flowers scattered over it.

entities.name: light gray handheld device
entities.identification: A light gray, flat, elongated device by Person A's hand, with a dark area and a red marking.

entities.name: dark-handled, broad, flat tool
entities.identification: A diagonally upright tool with a slender dark handle connected to a broad brown-gray end, whose bottom edge has a fine toothed outline.

entities.name: wooden post beside the path
entities.identification: A partially visible brown-gray vertical post beside the path at the upper left.

entities.name: white radial-line effect
entities.identification: A group of fine, short white radial lines appearing around the small dark hardware on the wooden door.
